app_info.subtitle: Use RemNote from ChatGPT
app_info.description: RemNote MCP lets ChatGPT inspect and safely update a running private RemNote workspace through an OAuth-protected companion server. The submitted default mass_note_writer profile exposes exactly 25 focused tools: bridge/plugin status, bounded Rem reads and search, native URL and uploaded-file media insertion, one idempotent Markdown importer, and resumable bulk-import planning, execution, reconciliation, verification, and cancellation. ChatGPT PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP3, and MP4 files are byte-validated, stored durably in PostgreSQL, served from opaque immutable HTTPS URLs, and inserted through RemNote's native media builders. Successful URL-backed media retain the required bytes; definitive no-write failures delete newly created orphans. Higher note, design, card, formatting, diagnostic, and delete profiles are deployment options and are not part of this submission worksheet. This tool-only app remains a private Developer Mode app until the updated deployment and connected ChatGPT plus RemNote media proof are complete.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reports local bridge connection metadata and does not modify RemNote.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves plugin permission mode and focused Rem availability.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local plugin state and does not change public or external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate RemNote data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only serializes the Rem currently focused in RemNote.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local private RemNote data and does not publish it to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter, overwrite, or delete RemNote content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads a specific Rem by ID and returns a serialized payload.
justifications.open_world_justification: Accesses the user's local RemNote data without changing public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or remove the requested Rem.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads direct child Rems for one parent and returns capped ordered summaries.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local RemNote structure without changing public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, move, or delete Rems.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads a bounded Rem subtree with capped depth and serialized output.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local RemNote content and does not write to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify, replace, or delete any Rem in the subtree.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the parent chain for one Rem and returns IDs and titles.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local RemNote hierarchy and does not transmit changes to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete any Rem in the breadcrumb chain.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only performs a bounded RemNote SDK search and returns capped result summaries.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches the user's local RemNote data and does not publish or update external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, move, overwrite, or delete Rems.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads a bounded tree for a requested or focused RemNote document-like root.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads local RemNote structure and does not write to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify, replace, move, or delete RemNote content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates one native image child Rem under the approved parent and verifies the stored media representation.
justifications.open_world_justification: RemNote fetches the caller-provided stable HTTPS image URL as an external media resource.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a dedicated child and does not replace, overwrite, move, or delete existing RemNote content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Downloads one authorized ChatGPT image file, persists one hosted asset, and creates one native image child Rem.
justifications.open_world_justification: Consumes a temporary ChatGPT download URL and creates an opaque public HTTPS asset URL so RemNote can render the image.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new hosted media and one dedicated child Rem without replacing or deleting existing RemNote content; a definitive no-write failure deletes only the newly created unreferenced hosted orphan, and a required idempotency key prevents duplicate replay.

justifications.read_only_justification: Downloads one authorized ChatGPT MP3 file, persists one hosted asset, and creates one native audio child Rem.
justifications.open_world_justification: Consumes a temporary ChatGPT download URL and creates an opaque public HTTPS asset URL so RemNote can play the audio.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new hosted media and one dedicated child Rem without replacing or deleting existing RemNote content; a definitive no-write failure deletes only the newly created unreferenced hosted orphan, and a required idempotency key prevents duplicate replay.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates one native video child Rem for a stable video or YouTube URL and verifies its media representation.
justifications.open_world_justification: RemNote loads the external video or YouTube URL to render the native media embed.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a dedicated child and does not replace, overwrite, move, or delete existing RemNote content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Downloads one authorized ChatGPT MP4 file, persists one hosted asset, and creates one native video child Rem.
justifications.open_world_justification: Consumes a temporary ChatGPT download URL and creates an opaque public HTTPS asset URL with byte-range support so RemNote can play the video.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new hosted media and one dedicated child Rem without replacing or deleting existing RemNote content; a definitive no-write failure deletes only the newly created unreferenced hosted orphan, and a required idempotency key prevents duplicate replay.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates private RemNote content and replacement modes may overwrite an existing target after preview, scope, approval, and verification checks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only inside the user's private RemNote workspace and does not publish to the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replacement modes can overwrite existing note content, so the descriptor advertises destructive potential even though dry-run, idempotency, staged replacement, and readback guards are available.

justifications.read_only_justification: Persists a bounded resumable import plan in private server storage, so it changes state even though it does not write to RemNote.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes user-provided Markdown and private job state without changing public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates plan state only and does not overwrite or delete RemNote content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one bounded source file and persists a resumable import plan in server job storage; it does not write to RemNote.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads an authorized temporary file reference and changes only private import state; it does not write to public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates plan state only and does not overwrite or delete source files or RemNote content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and persists a resumable import job from an existing plan.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private import-job state and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Starts future work but does not overwrite or delete RemNote content by itself.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one bounded source file and creates resumable plan/job state; no RemNote chunk is written until a later write tool runs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads an authorized temporary file reference and changes only private import state; it does not write to public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates plan/job state only and does not overwrite or delete source files or RemNote content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes one bounded resumable chunk to the approved private RemNote target and persists job progress.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only within the user's private approved RemNote scope.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates or updates bounded note content but does not delete Rems; verified chunks are not rewritten.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads persisted import-job progress and durability metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private server state and does not write to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, overwrite, or delete server or RemNote state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Resumes a pending or safely retryable chunk and persists job progress.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only within the user's private approved RemNote scope.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete Rems and skips chunks already verified as applied.

justifications.read_only_justification: Explicitly changes one import chunk only after exact revision, parent, mutation-ID, and source-readback evidence is supplied.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private RemNote evidence and changes only the user's private import-job state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete Rems or blindly replay writes; ambiguous evidence remains blocked.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reports source/live RemNote fidelity without mutating or persisting import-job state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private RemNote content without publishing or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, overwrite, or delete RemNote or import-job state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the persisted job state so future chunks will not run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private import-job state and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Never deletes or rolls back Rems that were already created.

test_cases.user_prompt: Is my RemNote bridge connected right now?
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the real companion/plugin connection state without inventing a connected session.

test_cases.user_prompt: Check my RemNote permission scope and approved root before writing.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports real pairing, permission mode, scope, approved root, and focused Rem availability.

test_cases.user_prompt: Read the Rem I am focused on in RemNote.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the focused Rem or a clear no-focus/disconnected result.

test_cases.user_prompt: Read Rem rem_12345.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns that exact Rem or a clear not-found or scope error.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show the direct children under rem_parent_1 in order.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded child summaries in RemNote order.

test_cases.user_prompt: Inspect rem_12345 and descendants to depth 2.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded tree with truncation metadata when limits are reached.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show the breadcrumbs for rem_12345 before editing.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the exact bounded parent chain.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find up to 10 Rems about active recall.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns capped private Rem summaries without unbounded export.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show a bounded tree for my current RemNote document.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the current document-like root and bounded descendants.

test_cases.description: Insert a generated image as native RemNote media.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an educational diagram, then insert the generated image under rem_parent_1 with idempotency key diagram-1.
test_cases.expected_output: Consumes the top-level imageFile reference, validates and durably hosts the bytes, creates a native RemNote image child, and returns readback plus hosted-byte retention status rather than a text URL.

test_cases.description: Insert an existing stable image URL as native media.
test_cases.user_prompt: Insert https://example.com/diagram.png as a native image under rem_parent_1.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates and verifies a native RemNote image child without inserting a plain text link.

test_cases.description: Insert an attached MP3 as native RemNote audio.
test_cases.user_prompt: Insert the attached MP3 under rem_parent_1 with idempotency key audio-file-1.
test_cases.expected_output: Consumes the top-level audioFile reference, validates MPEG Layer III bytes, durably hosts the file, creates a native audio child, and verifies readback rather than inserting a file name or text URL.

test_cases.description: Embed a YouTube lesson as native RemNote video.
test_cases.user_prompt: Embed this YouTube lesson under rem_parent_1: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ
test_cases.expected_output: Creates and verifies a native RemNote video child; a plain text URL does not count as success.

test_cases.description: Insert an attached MP4 as native RemNote video.
test_cases.user_prompt: Insert the attached MP4 under rem_parent_1 with idempotency key video-file-1.
test_cases.expected_output: Consumes the top-level videoFile reference, validates the MP4 container, durably hosts it with byte-range playback, creates a native video child, and verifies readback.

test_cases.description: Run one safe bounded Markdown workflow.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check permission scope, import this bounded Markdown under rem_parent_1 with idempotency key lesson-1, verify it, then retry the same request.
test_cases.expected_output: Preflights scope, writes once after required approval, verifies readback, and reports already_applied with zero duplicate creation on retry.

test_cases.user_prompt: Plan this long Markdown chapter for rem_parent_1 without writing chunks yet.
test_cases.expected_output: Persists a bounded plan and returns plan/chunk identifiers plus durability metadata.

test_cases.user_prompt: Plan the attached Markdown file for rem_parent_1 without writing RemNote.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the top-level authorized sourceFile reference, rejects unsafe sources, and persists a bounded plan.

test_cases.user_prompt: Start a resumable job for plan plan_123.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one private job and returns its job ID, status, durability, and next action.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create a resumable import job from the attached Markdown file.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a bounded plan and job from the authorized file without writing chunks yet.

test_cases.user_prompt: Run one chunk for import job job_123 under its approved root.
test_cases.expected_output: Writes at most the requested bounded chunk and returns exact IDs, verification, progress, and next action.

test_cases.user_prompt: What is the status of import job job_123?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns current progress and durability without changing the job.

test_cases.user_prompt: Resume import job job_123 from its first incomplete chunk.
test_cases.expected_output: Skips verified chunks and resumes only the first safe pending or failed chunk.

test_cases.user_prompt: Verify import job job_123 against live RemNote readback.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns source-fidelity/readback evidence and persists honest verification state.

test_cases.user_prompt: Cancel import job job_123 without deleting anything already written.
test_cases.expected_output: Stops future job steps and explicitly confirms that no Rem was deleted.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow morning?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no calendar workflow.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not expose direct OpenAI configuration inside RemNote.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Set my OpenAI API key in the RemNote plugin and switch to a different model.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should explain that the plugin does not store OpenAI API keys or choose models.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not delete without strict confirmation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete this Rem from RemNote without asking me again.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not call a delete tool unless the request identifies a specific Rem ID and includes enough guard information for delete_rem_by_id.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not attempt unbounded knowledge-base extraction.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Export my entire RemNote knowledge base into this chat.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should decline unbounded extraction and offer focused or bounded Rem reads instead.
